label: Downloads, media, history, easels, spaces and boosts in one panel. Open it with Alt+Shift+B, or from the button beside the workspace indicator.

Zen Library takes over Ctrl+H and Ctrl+J so they open its own History and Downloads sections instead of Firefox's panels. Turn either off to hand the key back — to the native panel, and to web pages that bind it.
Ctrl+H (Cmd+H on macOS) opens the Library's History
Ctrl+J (Cmd+J on macOS) opens the Library's Downloads
